description: frapea's BUILT-IN sound-effects pack — synthesized, licence-free, no API key, no download wait. Reach for this FIRST; use search_sounds only for something the pack does not cover (ambience, foley, a specific real-world object). Call with no `ids` to get the catalogue: each sound carries what it sounds like AND when to use it. Call with `ids` to copy them into the project's media pool as `sfx-<id>.wav` at the Library root; each result gives a mediaRef ready for add_clips on an audio track. Adding a sound already in the project is a no-op that returns its existing mediaRef.

ids.description: Sound ids to add (e.g. ['whip','thump','ding']). Omit to list the pack.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: add_sfx
